name: days_until
description: Count the whole days from today to a date or a named holiday (christmas, new year, halloween, ...), or since a past date.

date.description: a holiday name (christmas), a date like 'december 25' or '25 december' or 2027-01-05, or a weekday like friday

not_for: the current time or date (use time)
setting a reminder for a date
